Department Overview
  
  

Gas Engineering is focused on ensuring the safe and reliable flow of natural gas to our customers. As a part of Gas Engineering, the Gas Transmission Engineering and Design group (GTED) focuses on providing the technical direction and design of gas transmission pipeline and facility projects, and supporting the execution of the work in the field. The group also provides technical review and approval of project documentation post construction to ensure company records are updated accurately and reflect the scope of work performed. The Materials Management team within GTED is responsible for supporting project material needs, and ensuring traceable, verifiable, and complete (TVC) records are available for the materials we install per federal code requirements.

This Expert Gas Program Manager position provides strategic leadership and oversight for materials traceability and materials management within PG\&E’s Gas Engineering team, supporting both transmission and distribution systems. This role is responsible for ensuring that all gas\-related materials are fully traceable, compliant, and aligned with federal, state, and corporate regulatory requirements.

Materials Traceability \& Regulatory Compliance

* Partner with Supplier Quality Assurance (SQA), Supplier Quality Engineering (SQE), manufacturers, and vendors to resolve documentation gaps and validate material quality.

* Manage inventory lifecycle activities, including reallocation of surplus materials, resolution of aged inventory, and optimization of material utilization.
* Establish and manage centralized materials intake processes to ensure consistent tracking, accountability, and responsiveness.
* Partner with planning and supply chain teams to proactively mitigate material\-related schedule risks.


Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Strategy
  
* Serve as a key liaison across Gas Engineering, Gas Strategy Execution, GIS Mapping, Asset Knowledge Management, Standards Engineering, Warehouse Operations, and external partners.
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives to resolve systemic data gaps, improve standards, and align processes across organizations.
* Facilitate stakeholder engagement, drive decision\-making, and secure approvals for process and documentation changes.
* Contribute to the development and scaling of the Materials Management function, including process design, training, and operational readiness.


Performance Management \& Reporting
  
* Develop and maintain performance metrics and dashboards (e.g., Power BI) to monitor operational efficiency, compliance, and data quality.
* Track and report key performance indicators such as resolution cycle time, traceability accuracy, and material availability.

**Job Title:** Case Manager

**Department:** Case Management

**Reports to:** CPMS

**SUMMARY**

Counsels and aids children in care requiring foster placement through Foster Texas by providing case management services

**ZERO TOLERANCE POLICY FOR ABUSE**

All staff acknowledge the organization’s zero\-tolerance policy towards any form of child abuse – whether verbal, physical or sexual. All allegations or suspicions of abuse are taken seriously and will be reported to TX DFPS for investigation. All staff are responsible for clear conduct of standards and maintaining a culture of safety and abuse prevention.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING**

Other duties may be assigned as necessary.

* Provides case management services to children and assists staff with compliance.
* Facilitates the placement of children.
* Participates in the development of assessment, service delivery, discharge, and aftercare planning.
* Reports any/all suspecting abuse or neglect to the Administrator on duty and they immediately report the information to txabusehotline.org
* Maintains regular contact with family and child and monitors psychological, mental, emotional, physical, and environmental well\-being through phone contacts, email and initial home visits.
* Provides resource information and referrals to community organizations for therapeutic treatment such as behavior modification, stress management, and therapy to assist clients in controlling disorders and other problems.
* Helps families develop a therapeutic milieu conducive to healthy child development.
* Provides crisis intervention as needed to prevent escalation of high\-risk behavior, relapse, hospitalization, placement disruption, and other negative outcomes, while on\-site.
* Provides "on call" services on a regular and equal basis or covers "on call" schedule – including providing awake, continuous coverage throughout the night to meet the needs of a child if needed;
* Consult with medical doctors and other specialists, and/or treatment team members concerning treatment plans and make recommendations as needed.
* Inputs and updates child and family information into the Casebook information system, in the interim will document on a case note.
* Ensures that medical and psychiatric appointments for diagnostic assessments are scheduled and completed within according to state regulations.
* Provides Aftercare Case Management services for clients leaving the care of Foster Texas.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES FOR ALL STAFF:**

* All are required to adhere to mandatory reporting standards, including reporting suspicions or allegations of child abuse directly to the TX DFPS Hotline. All staff understand that this responsibility may not be delegated to another person.
* All staff must follow policies and procedures related to maintaining healthy boundaries with clients and families and must adhere to procedures related to managing high\-risk activities and one\-to\-one interactions with clients and families.
* All staff are required to be to up to date on annual abuse prevention and reporting abuse trainings.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

The Case Manager shall possess experience in working with children and families. The ideal candidate will have excellent writing skills for case notes. The Case Manager should be able to develop trust with families in order to assist them with effective care for children in their home.

**EDUCATION, LICENSURE and/or EXPERIENCE:**

The Case Manager shall possess a bachelor's degree in the Human Services field with one year of related experience.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret professional journals and general business periodicals. Ability to write reports, presentations, and business correspondence. Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of clergies, parishioners, managers, clients, customers, and the public.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS**

Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

**REASONING ABILITY**

Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions and deal with several abstract and concrete variables. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
